summary: IperionX Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a press release disclosing it was awarded up to US$6.6 million by the Office of the Secretary of War Submarine Workforce and Industrial Base (OSW-SWIB) to scale domestic production of ballistic-grade titanium plate for defense applications. The award is a government grant, not a corporate transaction. No securities, shareholder vote, advisor, or tender terms are involved. Phase 1 provides US$0.2 million for scoping, with a potential US$6.4 million follow-on. This is a routine operational funding disclosure with no special-situation characteristics; it is simply a contract award announcement.
